name: axon
description: Axon monorepo: the axon launcher plus the centralized management backend and frontend

scripts.check: bun run check:cli && bun run check:frontend && bun run check:backend && biome ci .
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test: bun run test:cli && bun run test:backend
scripts.check:frontend: cd apps/frontend && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
